confidence.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 해낼 수 있다거나 어떤 일이 꼭 그렇게 될 것이라고 스스로 굳게 믿음. 또는 그런 믿음.
confidence.englishDescription: A state in which one believes firmly that one can do something or something will be realized; such belief.
An act of believeing firmly in something; or such a state of mind.

confidence.definitionKo: 믿고 일을 맡김. 또는 그 믿음.
confidence.englishDescription: The act of entrusting someone with a task, or such trust.

confucianism.definitionKo: 중국 공자의 사상을 중심으로 하고 사서오경을 경전으로 하는 학문.
confucianism.englishDescription: The field of study based on the thoughts of Confucius of China, whose religious texts are the four books and five classics.

confucianism.definitionKo: 삼강오륜을 덕목으로 하며 사서삼경을 경전으로 하는, 종교로서의 유학.
confucianism.englishDescription: The religion taking the three principles and the five moral disciplines in human relations as virtues, whose central religious texts are the four books and five classics.

contemplating.definitionKo: 어떤 것에 대하여 깊이 생각하고 그 근본 뜻을 찾는.
contemplating.englishDescription: Thinking deeply about a certain thing and searching for its fundamental meaning.

contraindication.definitionKo: 치료 등의 의학적인 이유로 어떤 행위나 음식을 금하는 일.
contraindication.englishDescription: The act of forbidding certain behavior or food for medical reasons such as treatment.

contravene.definitionKo: 법, 명령, 약속 등을 지키지 않고 어기다.
contravene.englishDescription: To break the law, an order, promise, etc.

contravene.definitionKo: 법, 명령, 약속 등을 지키지 않고 어기다.
contravene.englishDescription: To break the law, an order, promise, etc.

conundrum.definitionKo: 수수께끼 같아서 풀기 힘든 어려운 문제.
conundrum.englishDescription: A problem that is puzzling and difficult to solve.

cord.definitionKo: 물건에 붙어서 잡아매거나 손잡이로 쓰는 물건.
cord.englishDescription: An object attached to another object, which is used to tie something or used as a handle.

cord.definitionKo: 무엇을 연결하는 데 쓰는 긴 줄.
cord.englishDescription: A long rope used to connect things.

cord.definitionKo: 물건을 꿰는 끈이나 꼬챙이. 또는 거기에 무엇을 꿴 것.
cord.englishDescription: A string or stick for threading things; things threaded on a string or stick.

cord.definitionKo: 여러 가닥의 얇은 실을 꼬아서 만든 끈.
cord.englishDescription: A string made by twisting several threads.

counsel.definitionKo: 형사 소송에서 피의자나 피고인을 위해 변호하는 사람.
counsel.englishDescription: A person who defends a suspect or the accused in a criminal action.

counsel.definitionKo: 어떤 문제를 해결하기 위해 서로 이야기하다.
counsel.englishDescription: To talk to one another to solve a certain problem.

criminality.definitionKo: 범죄가 되거나 범죄를 저지를 만한 성질.
criminality.englishDescription: Something criminal or likely to commit a crime.

cringe.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 남에게 꼼짝하지 못하거나 비굴하게 굴다.
cringe.englishDescription: (slang) To act humble or cowardly before someone.

cult.definitionKo: 바람직하지 못한 교리 등으로 사회에 나쁜 영향을 끼치는 종교.
cult.englishDescription: A religious faith that has a negative effect on the society due to its undesirable doctrines, etc.

curled.definitionKo: 머리카락이 연달아 짧고 둥글게 말려 있는 모양.
curled.englishDescription: A word describing the shape of hair being curled up short.

daejeon.definitionKo: 충청도의 중앙에 있는 광역시. 충청도, 전라도, 경상도를 연결하는 관문이고 경부선과 호남선이 갈리는 교통의 중심지이다.
daejeon.englishDescription: The metropolitan city located in the middle of Chungcheong-do, or Chungcheong Province; the gateway connecting three Provinces; Chungcheong, Jeolla, and Gyeongsang; the transport center at which the Gyeongbuseon Line and the Honamseon Line diverge.

dazzling.definitionKo: 눈을 뜰 수 없을 만큼 빛이 매우 환하고 강하다.
dazzling.englishDescription: So bright and strong that it is hard to open one's eyes.

dazzling.definitionKo: 빛이 밝거나 강하여 똑바로 보기 어렵다.
dazzling.englishDescription: Hard to look straight at something due to strong light coming from it.
Very luxurious and fancy, and therefore stunningly beautiful.
In the state of being dazzlingly bright and shiny.

debauchery.definitionKo: 술과 여자에 빠져 좋지 못한 행동을 하는 것.
debauchery.englishDescription: Too much indulgence in drinking and womanizing, and the misdeeds that accompany this sort of lifestyle.

debauchery.definitionKo: 술, 도박, 여자 등에 빠져 행실이 좋지 못함.
debauchery.englishDescription: Indulgence in alcohol, gambling, women, etc., and immoral behavior.
Drinking and womanizing to such a degree that one leads a debauched life.

debauchery.definitionKo: 생활을 방탕하게 만드는 술과 여자와 노름.
debauchery.englishDescription: Drinking, womanizing and gambling to such a degree that one leads a debauched life.

debone.definitionKo: 생선이나 고기에서 뼈에 붙은 살을 떼어 내거나 가시를 골라내다.
debone.englishDescription: To separate flesh from bones or remove bones in a piece of fish or meat.

debone.definitionKo: 생선에서 가시를 골라내거나 고기에서 뼈에 붙은 살을 떼어 내다.
debone.englishDescription: To pick bones from fish or separate meat from bones.

defeatism.definitionKo: 승리나 성공에 대한 자신감이 없어서 무엇을 해 보기도 전에 스스로 포기하는 태도.
defeatism.englishDescription: An attitude of voluntarily giving up something before actually trying it, because of one’s lack of confidence about victory or success.

defective.definitionKo: 물건 등의 품질이나 상태가 좋지 않다.
defective.englishDescription: The quality or state of an item, etc., is not so good.

define.englishDescription: To make a new rule, law, etc.

define.definitionKo: 어려운 낱말이나 글의 뜻을 알기 쉽게 밝혀 말하다.
define.englishDescription: To explain the meaning of a difficult word or writing in a way that it is easy to understand.

define.definitionKo: 어떤 말이나 사물의 뜻을 명확히 밝혀 분명하게 정하다.
define.englishDescription: To identify and set clearly the meaning of a word or object.

delightfully.englishDescription: In a happy and delightful manner.

denominator.definitionKo: 분수나 분수식에서, 가로줄 아래에 있는 수 또는 식.
denominator.englishDescription: The number or expression that is under the line in a fraction or fractional expression.

devastation.englishDescription: An act of smashing or breaking something into pieces to bring it down.
A state of becoming exhausted and weakened.

devastation.definitionKo: 집, 땅, 숲 등이 거칠어져 못 쓰게 됨.
devastation.englishDescription: A state in which houses, land, a forest, etc., become forlorn and useless.

devastation.definitionKo: 정신이나 생활 등이 거칠어지고 메말라 감.
devastation.englishDescription: A state in which one's mind or life becomes dull and barren.

devastation.definitionKo: 집, 땅, 숲 등을 돌보지 않고 그냥 두어 거칠어지고 못 쓰게 됨. 또는 그렇게 만듦.
devastation.englishDescription: A state in which houses, land, a forest, etc., are left unattended, becoming forlorn and useless; or an act of making this happen.

devastation.definitionKo: 정신이나 생활 등이 거칠어지고 메마르게 됨. 또는 그렇게 만듦.
devastation.englishDescription: A state in which one's mind or life becomes dull and barren; or an act of making this happen.

dilapidation.englishDescription: The state of a building, etc., becoming old, collapsing, and falling apart.

dimension.englishDescription: In mathematics, a measure of spatial extent.

disclosure.definitionKo: 감추어져 있는 것을 남이 보거나 알 수 있도록 겉으로 드러냄.
disclosure.englishDescription: The act of revealing something hidden to make it known or visible.
A hidden thing being exposed and becoming known.
The act of revealing what has been hidden.
An act of exposing what has been hidden.

disclosure.definitionKo: 알려지지 않았거나 숨겨져 있던 사실을 드러내어 사람들에게 알림.
disclosure.englishDescription: An act of telling an unknown fact to someone or spreading it to the public.

disheveled.definitionKo: 털이 어지럽게 일어나거나 흐트러져 단정하지 못하다.
disheveled.englishDescription: Hair or fur stands up in a messy way or is disheveled.

diversify.englishDescription: For the appearances or methods of something to become diverse or complicated.

diversify.definitionKo: 모양이나 방법이 많아지거나 복잡해지다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
diversify.englishDescription: For the appearances or methods of something to become diverse or complicated; to make this happen.

diversify.definitionKo: 색깔, 모양, 종류, 내용 등이 여러 가지로 많아지다.
diversify.englishDescription: For colors, shapes, kinds, contents, etc., to become diverse.

diversify.definitionKo: 색깔, 모양, 종류, 내용 등이 여러 가지로 많아지다. 또는 그렇게 만들다.
diversify.englishDescription: For colors, shapes, kinds, contents, etc., to become diverse; to make this happen.

divination.definitionKo: 하늘의 이치와 사람의 운명 사이의 관계를 연구하고 점치는 것.
divination.englishDescription: Studying and fortune-telling the relationship between the laws of the universe and human destiny.
A sign resulting from telling one’s fortune.

do.definitionKo: 대한민국의 시, 군 등을 관할하는 가장 큰 지방 행정 구역.
do.englishDescription: A province, or the largest local administrative district that  has jurisdiction over a si, gun, etc., in Korea.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 일거리로 삼다.
do.englishDescription: To do something as one's task.

do.definitionKo: 무엇을 어떻게 하다.
do.englishDescription: To do something in a certain way.

do.definitionKo: 윷놀이에서 윷가락 세 개는 엎어지고 한 개는 뒤집어진 경우를 이르는 말.
do.englishDescription: In Yut Nori, a term used to describe a situation where three Yut sticks fall down and one is upside down.

do.definitionKo: 서양 음악에서, 7음 음계의 첫 번째 계이름.
do.englishDescription: In Western music, the name of the first note of the seven-note scale.

do.definitionKo: 이름이나 명단을 소리 내 읽으며 확인하다.
do.englishDescription: To check by reading aloud names or a list of names.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 능력을 보이거나 태도를 드러내다.
do.englishDescription: To show a skill or reveal a certain attitude.

do.definitionKo: (완곡한 말로) 똥이나 오줌을 싸다.
do.englishDescription: (euphemism) To defecate or urinate.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 행동을 상대편에게 하다.
do.englishDescription: To do an action to another person.

do.definitionKo: 장부나 일기 등을 쓰다.
do.englishDescription: To do bookkeeping or write a diary, etc.

do.definitionKo: 남을 위해 어떤 일이나 행동을 하다.
do.englishDescription: To do a certain task or behavior for others.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 태도를 나타내거나 특정한 행동을 하다.
do.englishDescription: To show a certain attitude or do a certain act.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 동작, 활동 등을 행하다.
do.englishDescription: To perform a certain move, action, activity, etc.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 방식으로 행위를 이루다.
do.englishDescription: To complete an action in a certain way.

do.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 일이 나열되거나 되풀이되는 것을 나타내는 말.
do.englishDescription: The word that indicates a series or repetition of two or more things.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 상황이 일어나면 그 뒤에 반드시 어떤 상황이 뒤따라옴을 나타내는 말.
do.englishDescription: The word that signals a certain situation is bound to be followed by another.

do.definitionKo: 음식물 등을 먹거나 마시거나 담배 등을 피우다.
do.englishDescription: To eat, drink, or smoke a cigarette, etc.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 지위나 역할을 맡다.
do.englishDescription: To assume a position or role.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 실제로 하다.
do.englishDescription: To do a certain task.

do.definitionKo: 이미 있는 어떤 것에 다른 것을 더하거나 포함함을 나타내는 조사.
do.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate an addition or inclusion of another thing to something that already exists.

do.definitionKo: 둘 이상의 것을 나열함을 나타내는 조사.
do.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to list two or more things.

do.definitionKo: 어떤 기준이나 기대에 모자라지만 받아들일 수 있음을 나타내는 조사.
do.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate the ability to accept something although it does not reach a standard or expectation.

do.definitionKo: 극단적인 경우를 들어 다른 경우는 말할 것도 없음을 나타내는 조사.
do.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used when giving an extreme case in order to show that it is obvious in another case.

do.definitionKo: 일반적이지 않은 경우나 의외의 경우를 강조함을 나타내는 조사.
do.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to emphasize an unusual case or unexpected case.

do.definitionKo: 놀라움, 감탄, 실망 등의 감정을 강조함을 나타내는 조사.
do.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to emphasize emotions such as a surprise, exclamation, disappointment, etc.

do.definitionKo: 괜찮거나 아무 문제가 없다.
do.englishDescription: To be all right or no problem.

dolphin.definitionKo: 작은 이빨이 있고 주둥이가 가늘고 길며 머리가 좋아 기르며 훈련을 시키기도 하는 작은 고래.
dolphin.englishDescription: A small whale with small teeth, a long, narrow snout, often raised and trained by people because it is a highly intelligent animal.

dongnipsinmun.definitionKo: 1896년 독립 협회의 서재필이 중심이 되어 만든 한국 최초의 민간 신문. 최초의 한글 신문이기도 하다.
dongnipsinmun.englishDescription: The first Korean private newspaper in Hangeul published in 1896 by the Independence Club, which was founded through the initiative of Seo Jaepil.

dude.definitionKo: (낮추거나 친근하게 이르는 말로) 나이가 비슷하거나 아래인 사람.
dude.englishDescription: (impolite form or affectionate) A person who is about the same age as or younger than one.

dude.definitionKo: 친근한 상대편을 가리키거나 부를 때 사용하는 말.
dude.englishDescription: The word that is used to refer to or call a person that one feels close to.
The honorific or addressee-lowering form that is used to call a man.

dullard.englishDescription: (teasing) A person who acts slowly and foolishly.

durable.englishDescription: A will or thought being strong without being shaken.

dynasty.definitionKo: 같은 집안에서 난 왕들의 계열. 또는 그런 왕들이 다스리는 시대.
dynasty.englishDescription: A succession of kings who were born in the same family; a period of time for which such kings rule over a country.

editing.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 대상을 몹시 심하게 함부로 다룸.
editing.englishDescription: (figurative) The act of dealing harshly and recklessly with a certain object.

editing.definitionKo: 남이 쓴 글이나 답안 등에 내용을 일부 보태거나 삭제하여 고침.
editing.englishDescription: An act of revising another person's writing, answers, etc., by adding, deleting, or correcting.

editing.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 글이나 영화 등을 편집할 때 내용의 일부를 삭제하는 것.
editing.englishDescription: (figurative) An act of deleting content when editing a written piece of work or movie, etc.

editing.definitionKo: 일정한 방향과 계획 아래 여러 가지 자료를 모아 신문, 잡지, 책 등을 만듦. 또는 영화 필름, 녹음테이프, 문서 등을 하나의 작품으로 완성함.
editing.englishDescription: An act of gathering various materials under a fixed direction and plan into a newspaper, a magazine, a book, etc., or an act of completing a movie film, recorded tape, document, etc., into a piece of work.

editing.definitionKo: 책을 쓰거나 만드는 일을 지도하고 감독함.
editing.englishDescription: The act of supervising and directing in the writing or publishing process of a book.

elation.definitionKo: 일이 자기 뜻대로 잘되어 뽐내는 기세가 대단함.
elation.englishDescription: The state of being filled with pride and high spirits because everything turned out as desired.
The state of being satisfied with or boasting about an achievement.

elation.definitionKo: 원하던 일을 이루어 만족스럽고 자랑스러운 마음이 얼굴에 나타난 모양.
elation.englishDescription: An expression on one's face that appears satisfied and proud, as one has achieved what one wanted to achieve.

embarrassment.definitionKo: 놀라거나 매우 급하여 어떻게 해야 할지를 모름.
embarrassment.englishDescription: A state in which a person is at a loss what to do as he/she is frightened or in a hurry.

embarrassment.definitionKo: 갑자기 어떤 일을 당하여 정신을 못 차리고 어떻게 해야 할지를 모르는 감정.
embarrassment.englishDescription: The emotion in which one feels puzzled and does not know what to do, facing an unexpected event.

embarrassment.definitionKo: 체면이 깎이는 어떤 일이나 사실 때문에 몹시 부끄러움.
embarrassment.englishDescription: A feeling of being very ashamed due to a disgraceful event or fact.

embellishment.definitionKo: 글이나 문장의 표현을 화려하고 기교 있게 꾸밈.
embellishment.englishDescription: An embellishment of the expression in a composition or sentence in a fanciful and stylish manner.
(figurative) The state of exaggerating or beautifying an incident.

en.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 내용이 뒤에 오는 내용보다 마음에 차지 않기 때문에 뒤의 내용을 선택함을 강조하여 나타내는 조사.
en.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to emphasize that the speaker will choose the following content, because the content of the preceding statement is less satisfactory.
A postpositional particle used to emphasize that the statement reflects one's own perspective or judgment.

en.definitionKo: 있을 수 없는 사실을 강조하기 위해 그런 경우나 상황을 제한하여 나타내는 조사.
en.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to refer to an improbable case or situation restrictively in order to emphasize it.
A postpositional particle used to emphasize the basis for one's judgment.

en.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 장소나 시간을 강조하거나 대조하는 뜻을 나타내는 조사.
en.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to emphasize the place or time of the preceding statement or compare it with another.

en.definitionKo: 그 대상을 강조하거나 대조하는 뜻을 나타내는 조사.
en.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to emphasize a certain object or compare it with another.

enervated.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 수 있는 기운이나 힘이 없다.
enervated.englishDescription: Having no energy or strength to do something.

enervated.definitionKo: 몹시 지치고 고단하여 몸이 축 늘어질 정도로 힘이 없다.
enervated.englishDescription: Lacking energy, feeling enervated because one is extremely tired and burned out.

enumeration.englishDescription: The act of putting things in order.

enumeration.definitionKo: 여러 가지 예나 사실 등을 하나하나 죽 늘어놓음.
enumeration.englishDescription: The act of mentioning several examples, facts, etc., one by one.

equilibrate.definitionKo: 변하거나 흔들리지 않고 일정한 상태를 유지하게 하다.
equilibrate.englishDescription: To make a certain state maintained without being changed or shaken.

escaping.definitionKo: 무엇을 피해 도망가거나 외면하려고 하는 것.
escaping.englishDescription: Trying to escape or turn away from something.

eumnyeokseol.englishDescription: Lunar New Year's Day: The first day of the new year by the lunar calendar.

warm.definitionKo: 아주 덥지 않고 기분 좋은 정도로 알맞게 높은 온도로.
warm.englishDescription: In an appropriately high temperature that is pleasing, not too hot.

warm.definitionKo: 뜨겁지 않을 정도로 온도가 알맞게 높다.
warm.englishDescription: A temperature being not hot but appropriately high.

warm.definitionKo: 뜨겁지 않을 정도로 온도가 알맞게 높다.
warm.englishDescription: A temperature being not hot but appropriately high.

warm.definitionKo: 아주 덥지 않고 기분이 좋은 정도로 온도가 알맞게 높다.
warm.englishDescription: Being an appropriate, pleasant temperature, which is not too high.
(figurative) Intense and strong in feeling, passion, etc.

warm.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 아끼고 위하는 마음이 진실하고 지극하다.
warm.englishDescription: One's mind of treating someone kindly being sincere and faithful.

warm.definitionKo: 대하는 태도가 정성스럽고 마음을 다하여 애를 쓰는 데가 있다.
warm.englishDescription: One's attitude of treating someone being sincere and wholehearted.
Evoking feelings of warmth and closeness.
The weather being windless and quite warm.

warm.definitionKo: 마음을 부드럽게 해 주는 따뜻한 기운이 있다.
warm.englishDescription: Having warmth that softens the heart.

warm.definitionKo: 날씨나 온도가 견디기 좋을 만큼 따뜻하다.
warm.englishDescription: The weather or temperature being bearably warm.

warm.definitionKo: 마음을 부드럽게 녹여 주는 따뜻함이 있다.
warm.englishDescription: Having warmth that softens the heart.

washbasin.definitionKo: 얼굴을 씻기 위한 물을 담는 그릇.
washbasin.englishDescription: A bowl to hold the water for washing one's face.

washbasin.definitionKo: 손과 얼굴을 씻을 수 있도록 수도와 물 받는 곳을 갖추어 놓은 시설.
washbasin.englishDescription: A basin connected with a water supply, for washing one's hands and face.

willful.definitionKo: 자기 생각이나 주장을 굽힐 줄 모르고 굳게 버티는 태도가 있다.
willful.englishDescription: Taking the attitude of being stubborn and insisting on an idea or opinion.

winding.englishDescription: Curved here and there, not straight.

winding.definitionKo: 모양이 곧지 않고 이리저리 구부러져 있다.
winding.englishDescription: Curved here and there, not straight.

winding.definitionKo: 곧거나 바르지 않고 이리저리 기울어지거나 구부러져 있다.
winding.englishDescription: Tilted or crooked in places, not straight.

withdrawal.englishDescription: The act of avoiding being related to something.
The act of drawing something out.

withdrawal.definitionKo: 은행 등의 금융 기관에서 맡겨 둔 돈을 찾음.
withdrawal.englishDescription: The act of taking out money from a financial institution like a bank, etc.

withdrawal.definitionKo: 이미 제출했던 것이나 주장했던 것을 다시 거두어들이거나 취소함.
withdrawal.englishDescription: An act of revoking or cancelling something that was submitted or argued.
An act of cancelling an application, document, etc., which was submitted.

withdrawal.definitionKo: 은행과 같은 금융 기관의 계좌에서 돈을 뺌.
withdrawal.englishDescription: An act of taking money out of one’s account in a financial institution such as a bank.

withdrawal.definitionKo: 겉으로 드러나지 않도록 깊숙이 가라앉거나 숨음.
withdrawal.englishDescription: An act of sinking or hiding deeply, in order not to be seen from outside.
The state of an atmosphere, etc., feeling heavy and quiet, because it is depressed.

withdrawal.definitionKo: 있던 곳에서 시설이나 장비 등을 거두어 가지고 물러남.
withdrawal.englishDescription: An act of gathering up the equipment, supplies, etc., and leaving a place where one has been stationed.
An act of pulling back in a fight, war, project, etc.

withdrawal.definitionKo: 소속해 있던 조직이나 단체에서 관계를 끊고 나옴.
withdrawal.englishDescription: An act of ending one's relationship with an organization or group one had belonged to and leaving.
An act of leaving a post, place, etc., voluntarily, or being expelled.
An act of clearing a place where one stays and withdrawing.
An act of pulling back in a fight, war, project, etc.
An act of calling back troops or troops going back from a mission.

wolfberry.definitionKo: 주로 말려서 차와 약으로 쓰이는 빨갛고 길쭉한 열매.
wolfberry.englishDescription: A red, long fruit that is mainly dried and used as tea and medicine.

wrath.englishExpression: rage; fury; violent anger; wrath; exasperation

wrath.englishDescription: A feeling of rage and mortification.

wrath.definitionKo: 남이 맞서지 못할 만큼 강하고 날카로운 기세.
wrath.englishDescription: A strong and sharp energy from a person that intimidates others.

wrath.definitionKo: 몹시 화를 내며 노여워함. 또는 그런 감정.
wrath.englishDescription: The state of being enraged and frustrated, or such a feeling.
